name: Surviving Mars: Pioneer Holiday Pack
summary:
Let's be honest, you're not going to make it home for the holidays. Mars is just too demanding. But don't worry - mission control can provide you with all the holiday spirit you need.

Feel the festive cheer with all the decorative items your hub has been missing: Christmas Trees, presents, and stockings. This pack includes 18 items for your jolly holidays alone on the red planet. 

Happy Holidays, Pioneer.
